entries.name: Potter's grip
entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Potter's grip

**Target:** One adjacent creature. **Player defense:** Brawn. **Damage type:** physical.

**Weak defense:** Grappled 2. **Standard defense:** Grappled 1.

**Limit:** The holder suffers its own Grappled contribution. A new result replaces its lower contribution, not adds to it. Release freely; separation beyond reach, unconsciousness or death ends the hold.

entries.name: Shed the Grasp
entries.effect: Reduce one holder’s Grappled contribution by 1.
entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Shed the Grasp

*The surface peels away, leaving a useless handful while the body gathers again.*

Choose one holder and reduce that holder’s Grappled contribution by 1, also reducing this creature’s total Grappled rating by 1. End that hold if its contribution reaches 0. It must have a Maneuver available; cannot use this while Grappled 3. No damage or free movement.

entries.name: Lock the Frame
entries.effect: Before forced movement on solid ground: Stability 3 for that movement.
entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Lock the Frame

*The joints grind shut and the body becomes a single weight planted against the shove.*

Before this creature is forcibly moved while on solid ground, gain Stability 3 for that forced movement only. Use the highest source. In a collision chain, declare before its Stability is deducted; prior collision damage still resolves. This does not resist Prone or grapples.

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

**Lifeless Body — Passive:** Does not breathe or eat; only its listed immunities apply.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 2; an explicit trait, not a bonus calculated from Size.

**Healing:** Construct: ordinary living-target healing does not repair it; a repair ability must explicitly permit constructs.

**Senses:** Dark sight 6 squares; ordinary hearing.

**Tactics and retreat:** Hold one intruder while guarding the command tablet. Shed a hostile grasp only while a Maneuver remains available.

**Encounter and conversation:** The command tablet is cracked; restoring the missing words can end a task that has become dangerous.

**Habitat:** Workshop; old civic building; sealed vault · **Communication:** None

**Loot:** Recoverable possessions or lair clues chosen for the adventure; body parts grant no automatic special equipment or coin value.

**Summoning:** Construct 7 — [player reference](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/summons/clay-golem.md).

## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-clay-golem


**Category:** Construct · **Role:** Holder · **CV:** 36

### CV worksheet

**Reference damage:** 3/6/9

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.5

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.45 → 1.5: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.05. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=3.000, O=5.894. Uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/encounters.md). Utility is provisional and does not simulate control, positioning or summon choices.

**Ability sources:** [lifeless body](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/lifeless-body.md), [Lock the Frame](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/lock-the-frame.md), [seizing limbs](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/seizing-limbs.md), [slough skin](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/slough-skin.md).

**Coverage reference:** [Pathfinder family survey](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/family-survey.md); original HOL prose and mechanics.

# Lifeless Body

*Nothing breathes beneath the torn coat; nothing living looks through the visor.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-lifeless-body


**Action:** Passive

The card must list its exact condition immunities; this trait grants no additional unlisted ones. It does not breathe or need food. Undead entries marked healing-harmed take a healing result as Life damage; constructs marked repair-only do not regain HP from ordinary healing. Neither rule prevents physical attacks from dealing their normal minimum damage.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.
